requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area. The 18-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 360 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 360, the only requirement whose column is in both the runtime schema and filterable_columns. The tipologia_bene_immobile requirement was dropped because that column is not in filterable_columns (the allowlist rule). The capacity of 18 people has no matching column and was not in the extracted requirements, so it is not applied. No location is given, so results are ordered by id ascending.
